The game is set in the year 1912 and follows its protagonist, Booker DeWitt, who is sent to the airborne city Columbia to retrieve Elizabeth, a young woman held captive there. GBC:wario-land-3.d: Wario Land 3, known in Japan as Wario Land 3: Mysterious Music Box, is a 2000 platform game developed by Nintendo R&D1 and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Color. The game's plot centers around Wario who must free a mysterious figure who is trapped inside a music box. The game was released in Japan on March 21, 2000, Europe on April 14, 2000, and North America on May 30, 2000. The game was later re-released for the Nintendo 3DS Virtual Console in 2013, and as part of the Nintendo Classics service on February 8, 2023.

GBA:incredibles.d: The Incredibles is an action-adventure video game based on Disney/Pixar's 2004 film of the same name developed by Heavy Iron Studios and published by THQ. The game was released for the Game Boy Advance, GameCube, Mac OS X, PlayStation 2, Windows and Xbox. Samuel L. Jackson (Frozone/Lucius Best), Spencer Fox (Dash), Sarah Vowell (Violet), and Jason Lee (Buddy Pine/Syndrome/Incrediboy) reprise their roles from the film, with the rest of the cast being replaced by different voice actors. The game's music was composed by Michael Giacchino, who also scored the film.

Arcade:battle-circuit.d: Battle Circuit is a 1997 beat 'em up video game developed and published by Capcom for arcades. The game contains comic-like characters in a futuristic science fiction setting, and was Capcom's last beat 'em up game developed for arcades.
